summary.description: High-level summary of the secret scan run.

rule_id.description: Identifier for the secret type, e.g. aws-secret-key, generic-api-key, private-key.

path.description: Relative file path within the target repository.

line_number.description: Line number where the secret was observed.

snippet.description: Sanitized or masked snippet of the code containing the candidate secret.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the finding.

description.description: Explanation of the finding and whether it appears live or dormant.

remediation.description: Recommended remediation step (e.g. revoke, move to environment variable).
